The most recent October 2026 releases I found were from DeepSeek, Meta, Google, xAI, and Anthropic, with the newest on October 17.

- **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017** was released October 17, 2026, according to LLM Gateway's release timeline.
- **Meta Muse Spark Open** came out October 15. Meta describes it as its new open-weight model for coding and agent tasks, and the weights are free to download. Meta's top Muse Wonder models remain closed.
- **Nvidia Nemotron 3.5 Super VL** also released Oct 15 per one tracker, as an open-weights model.
- **Google Gemini 4 Argon** reached general availability on October 13. Google had first announced it on Sep 30, and it is now broadly available, after launching only to vetted cyber defenders.
- **xAI Grok Voice 3.0** was released by xAI on October 14, 2026.
- **Meta Muse Wonder 1.0** was released by Meta on October 12, 2026.
- **Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5** came out October 7, with a 1,000,000-token context and $0.10 in / $0.50 out per million tokens on the API.
- **OpenAI GPT-6** was released Oct 7, 2026 as part of an update to ChatGPT. GPT-6 is now the default in ChatGPT chat for everyone, with paid plans on GPT-6 Sol and Free and Go users on GPT-6 Luna.

The sources don't fully agree. One tracker lists the newest Meta release as Muse Spark Open, while another lists Anthropic's model names differently (one says Claude Fable 5.1 launched September 1, while another describes a Claude 5 family). These aggregator sites also disagree on some dates and prices, so check official provider announcements before relying on specific details.

Три найважливіші релізи моделей ШІ за 11–18 жовтня 2026 року:

1. **Meta Muse Wonder (12 жовтня).** Meta представила Muse Wonder і Muse Wonder Full і називає їх своїми найпотужнішими моделями для агентних завдань в особистій і робочій сфері. Джерело: [Digital Applied: October 2026 Tracker](https://www.digitalapplied.com/blog/ai-model-releases-october-2026-tracker)
2. **Meta Muse Spark Open (15 жовтня).** Це мультимодальна модель із відкритими вагами для кодування та агентних завдань: 816 млрд параметрів (з них 42 млрд активних) і контекстне вікно на 1 млн токенів. Джерело: [AI Front Page: October 2026 AI Model Launches](https://aifront-page.com/open-weights-october-2026-ai-model-launches/)
3. **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (17 жовтня).** Це найсвіжіший реліз у трекерах: оновлена «швидка» версія моделі DeepSeek V4.1. Джерело: [LLM Gateway: Timeline](https://llmgateway.io/timeline)

Gemini 4 Argon від Google став загальнодоступним 13 жовтня. Я не включив його до списку, бо модель анонсували раніше: за одними даними 30 вересня, за іншими 1 жовтня.
